look
inventory
help
go east

go east
go east
quit
notes:
Controls:
- Type commands by typing text and pressing Enter. Supported commands: look, go north, go south, go east, go west, take <item>, inventory, help, quit.
- Each command prints a confirmation line to stdout (e.g., LOOK, MOVED NORTH, TOOK lantern, INVENTORY, HELP, QUIT) and also shows game text in the window.
- Inputs can also be provided via stdin (one command per line) for automated tests; the game reads lines from stdin in a background thread.
- The game window title is 'Lantern Cave'.
- Restart: close and re-run the program.
- Events printed to stdout: LOOK, MOVED <DIRECTION>, BLOCKED, TOOK <item>, INVENTORY, HELP, QUIT, WIN.
